cases.description: Geometry change rebuilds dependent compiled task graph and downstream execution evidence.
Metadata-only change with verified equivalence preserves scoped claims.
Metadata-only label without equivalence receipt is not proof of semantic equivalence.
Frame change affects only same site/frame dependency paths.
Global frame definition change affects every dependent site.
Site A epoch change does not affect independent Site B evidence under complete closure.
Tool change requalifies tool-dependent capability and calibration claims.
Firmware change requires revalidation and applicable authority review.
Sensor replacement invalidates dependent sensor calibration and visibility evidence.
Material lot change affects dependent material/method/inspection evidence only.
Method sequence change rebuilds task graph and execution plan.
Changed transformation-rule digest invalidates derived outputs.
One element change leaves unrelated element unaffected only with granular closure.
Acceptance change invalidates derived accepted-output and productivity claims.
Expired calibration requires new measurement or review for dependent results.
Control-point correction propagates only through the relevant network/frame.
Revoked source evidence invalidates dependent claims.
Corrected source evidence creates a new immutable lineage and evaluation.
Cost basis change invalidates cost claims but not physical inspection.
Serial change triggers scoped capability/qualification review.
Missing edge and incomplete closure prohibit unaffected.
A closure manifest inconsistent with dependency records is rejected by an external corpus oracle.
Unknown event kind produces UnknownImpact.
Unknown delta does not yield unaffected.
Approval-requiring event without authority reference requires review.
Prior revision/digest mismatch is StaleInput.
Duplicate node identities are rejected.
Duplicate edge IDs or contradictory policies are rejected.
Cycle in invalidation edges is rejected with a cycle witness.
Explicit non-triggering edge coverage and complete closure justify unaffected.
Distinct triggered paths retain all required actions.
Multiple material paths are retained deterministically.
Identical event replay produces identical report.
Different policy digest creates a new evaluation identity.
Old receipt remains immutable but is no longer current for the new profile.
Coarse granularity prevents unsupported element-level unaffected claim.
Model-bound claims are revalidated; unrelated receipts remain historical.
Contraction invalidates newly out-of-scope operating area.
ODD expansion does not qualify newly included area.
Expired ODD evidence triggers requalification.
Revoked safety/permission receipt blocks dependent execution admission.
Conformity decisions using the old policy are revalidated; raw readings remain.
Reference-artifact correction reopens affected lab comparisons.
Cost credit/rate does not change accepted physical counts.
Approval dependencies are re-evaluated even when content digest remains.
New downstream use requires new applicability decision.
New dependent node does not change unrelated prior decisions.
Event applies through declared dependencies, not free-text matching.
Permutation of nodes/edges/rules preserves canonical output.
Same event ID with changed authority reference is a different event payload.
Out-of-valid-time change event requires review or stale disposition.
Configuration change re-evaluates measurement dependencies.
Compiler rebuild explains changed task identities and dependent claims.
Indirect path retains shortest/all material dependency witnesses.
Expired closure attestation forbids unaffected decisions.
